subject: MAP: Eval access & POC environment orchestration (API keys, org seed, IP allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Claire Benson <claire.benson@novacorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Lee <ryan.lee@novacorp.com>, itops@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC access requirements + proposed MAP timeline

Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move the PoC forward for the fraud-detection eval: key asks below so we can line up an internal kickoff and secure a prioritized window with infra. Happy to iterate on a MAP but this is our starting list: 

- Org setup: we need a Redwood tenant seeded with two team accounts (data-team, ml-team) and a read-only billing contact.
- API keys: one env-specific API key for staging, one for evaluation (scoped, rotateable).
- IP allowlist: we'll provide our egress ranges; request sample format and expected CIDR entry method.
- VPC peering: request a cross-account peering template and desired peering CIDR ranges. We also need to confirm whether peering can be scheduled in our AWS account during the Aug 4–8 maintenance window.

Goal: have environment ready and basic integration tests passing by Aug 15 so we can run the evaluation during the Aug 18–22 window. Can Redwood commit to the timeline? If not, propose alternatives.

I've attached a brief timeline and our current IP ranges.

Attachments: MAP_Timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), ip_allowlist_example.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Claire Benson
Product Ops 
NovaCorp
(707) 555-0199

---

[Note: we will share technical contacts separately if needed]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Benson <claire.benson@novacorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC access requirements + proposed MAP timeline

Claire —

Great to hear — excited to run this with NovaCorp. We can meet the core timeline with two small caveats (see below). Proposed immediate next steps (I attached a MAP template):

1) Kickoff meeting this Thurs 7/24, 10am PT — confirm infra points and sign owners.
2) Redwood will provision a tenant and create staged API keys within 48 hours after kickoff.
3) Neha will validate IP allowlist format and policy; Priyom will own peering orchestration.
4) If your Aug 4–8 window for peering is required, we need DocuSign authorization for account-level peering and a short maintenance approval (we'll include the template in the MAP).

Caveats: If NovaCorp requires cross-region peering or private connect, that extends lead time by ~7 business days. Also, if you require long-lived keys instead of scoped short-term keys we should review the security tradeoffs.

I attached the MAP_Timeline_v1.xlsx (filled with our proposed dates) and a blank MAP template for your legal/IT.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_Timeline_v1.xlsx (filled), MAP_Template_redwood_v1.xlsx (template)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: itops@novacorp.com, Claire Benson <claire.benson@novacorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC access requirements + proposed MAP timeline

Hi Claire / Nova IT —

Quick security checklist so we can sign the MAP: 
- API keys: we suggest scoped keys (staging / evaluation) with 30-day rotation cadence; can support short-lived bearer tokens via integration if preferred.
- Audit logs: Redwood provides per-tenant request logs and redactable payload logs for PII-sensitive routes; confirm whether you require log forwarding to your SIEM (e.g., Splunk or S3 bucket).
- Data retention: default 90 days for logs, can extend for enterprise plan (billing applies).

Please confirm: do you need SOC2 attestation copy for this contract? If so, I will attach the SOC2 packet to the MAP.

Also tagging Priyom to coordinate the peering window.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Aditya / team —

Thanks, that all looks good. Quick answers inline: 
- Peering: Aug 4–8 is our preferred window. We can sign the peering authorization DocuSign this week. Expectation is cross-account VPC peering within same AWS region (us-west-2).
- IP allowlist: attached CSV is our current egress ranges (ip_allowlist_example.csv). Format CIDR; we can add /32 entries for service boxes.
- Logs: we prefer S3 delivery for request logs (s3://novacorp-redwood-logs) with 90-day retention. No full SIEM push initially.
- SOC2: happy to receive the attestation packet — please attach.

Also confirming the kickoff on 7/24 10am PT. I'll invite our infra engineer Ryan and our security architect (cc'd).

Attachment: ip_allowlist_example.csv

Claire
